class LawfulMonadCont (m : Type u → Type v) [Monad m] [MonadCont m]
    extends LawfulMonad m : Prop where
  callCC_bind_right {α ω γ} (cmd : m α) (next : Label ω m γ → α → m ω) :
    (callCC fun f => cmd >>= next f) = cmd >>= fun x => callCC fun f => next f x
  callCC_bind_left {α} (β) (x : α) (dead : Label α m β → β → m α) :
    (callCC fun f : Label α m β => goto f x >>= dead f) = pure x
  callCC_dummy {α β} (dummy : m α) : (callCC fun _ : Label α m β => dummy) = dummy

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monad.Types
/-- The `Kleisli` category of a `Control.Monad` is equivalent to the `Kleisli` category of its
category-theoretic version, provided the monad is lawful.
-/
@[simps]
def eq : KleisliCat m ≌ Kleisli (ofTypeMonad m) where
  functor :=
    { obj := fun X => X
      map := fun f => f
      map_id := fun _ => rfl
      map_comp := fun f g => by
        --unfold_projs
        funext t
        -- Porting note: missing tactic `unfold_projs`, using `change` instead.
        change _ = joinM (g <$> (f t))
        simp only [joinM, seq_bind_eq, Function.id_comp]
        rfl }
  inverse :=
    { obj := fun X => X
      map := fun f => f
      map_id := fun _ => rfl
      map_comp := fun f g => by
        --unfold_projs
        -- Porting note: Need these instances for some lemmas below.
        --Should they be added as actual instances elsewhere?
        letI : _root_.Monad (ofTypeMonad m).obj :=
          show _root_.Monad m from inferInstance
        letI : LawfulMonad (ofTypeMonad m).obj :=
          show LawfulMonad m from inferInstance
        funext t
        dsimp
        -- Porting note: missing tactic `unfold_projs`, using `change` instead.
        change joinM (g <$> (f t)) = _
        simp only [joinM, seq_bind_eq, Function.id_comp]
        rfl }
  unitIso := by
    refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun X => Iso.refl X) fun f => ?_
    change f >=> pure = pure >=> f
    simp [functor_norm]
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.refl X

      Part where
  bind_pure_comp := @bind_some_eq_map
  id_map f := by cases f; rfl

  bind_assoc := @bind_assoc
  map_const := by simp [Functor.mapConst, Functor.map]

theorem iselect_eq_default [DecidableEq F.A] [Inhabited (M F)] (ps : Path F) (x : M F)
    (h : ¬IsPath ps x) : iselect ps x = head default := by
  induction' ps with ps_hd ps_tail ps_ih generalizing x
  · exfalso
    apply h
    constructor
  · cases' ps_hd with a i
    induction' x using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with x_a x_f
    simp only [iselect, isubtree] at ps_ih ⊢
    by_cases h'' : a = x_a
    · subst x_a
      simp only [dif_pos, eq_self_iff_true, casesOn_mk']
      rw [ps_ih]
      intro h'
      apply h
      constructor <;> try rfl
      apply h'
    · simp [*]

  dsimp [corec, destruct, get]

  apply Subtype.eq
